purpose: Dictionary resource for conservative Thai word maximum matching; not pronunciation gold and not an expert-adjudicated segmentation corpus.
source_license_evidence: PyThaiNLP documents the Thai word-list resource as CC0; retain source attribution and re-check upstream license if replacing the pinned snapshot.
transformation: Read the pinned UTF-8 source file in source order; trim trailing whitespace; keep nonempty lines whose every Unicode code point is in U+0E00–U+0E7F; de-duplicate exact strings while retaining the first occurrence; emit one entry per LF-terminated line. No Wisesight samples are used in dictionary construction. This filters mixed-script phrases and keeps dictionary evidence independent of the held-out Wisesight evaluation set.
limitations: A lexical dictionary is not a word-boundary gold set.
Maximum matching can over-segment or under-segment context-dependent forms.
Unknown graphemes are preserved and surfaced rather than silently discarded.
The dictionary contains orthographic entries, not pronunciations.
